description: Add tests for key admin endpoints to verify the router registration, auth guards, and response shapes. Focus on the most critical endpoints: dashboard, users, conversations, settings, analytics.
steps: Step 1: Create apps/backend/tests/test_admin_endpoints.py with pytest tests that validate: (a) unauthenticated requests to admin endpoints return 401, (b) authenticated requests to GET /admin/dashboard return expected shape, (c) GET /admin/users returns paginated list, (d) GET /admin/settings returns config object, (e) GET /admin/conversations returns list. Use the conftest.py client fixture with mocked MongoDB (mock Beanie document queries).
Step 2: Ensure all tests pass with mocked DB by patching beanie document find/aggregate methods. The tests should confirm that the auth guard works and that response schemas are correct.
Step 3: Run the full test suite to ensure no regressions from existing tests.
acceptance_criteria: test_admin_endpoints.py exists with at least 8 test cases
Tests validate that unauthenticated requests are rejected with 401
Tests validate response shapes for dashboard, users, conversations, settings
All tests pass with: python -m pytest tests/test_admin_endpoints.py -v
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_admin_endpoints.py -v
Run: cd apps/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -x --timeout=30
